senses.definition: (informal) A move to another place in the hope of curing an addiction etc.

quotes.text: At QA they called these 'Geographicals'. It was a common tactic of the alcoholic type to think that a move would make all the difference.
There were always too many geographicals. That is a change of address.
quotes.reference: 2014, Sonny Carbo, Instant Idiot Just Add Alcohol:

quotes.text:
'Doing Geographicals'
The word 'geographical' comes from the recovery community. It refers to one of the actions that an alcoholic mistakenly takes in order to 'fix' their problems.
